name: yam_sim
description: Bimanual i2rt YAM in the DreamGuard MuJoCo simulator
source: Joint ranges from MuJoCo Menagerie i2rt_yam/yam.xml (MIT, i2rt robotics)
notes: Joint limits are the model's hard ranges in radians; Dream-1 joint zero conventions must be verified against the first recorded chunk (Phase 7).
max_joint_step_rad and max_joint_velocity_rad_s are development guardrails; 11 recorded Dream-1 chunks peaked at 0.067 rad/row and 1.35 rad/s.
gripper_tolerance: Dream-1's smoothed gripper commands undershoot a closed gripper by up to 0.012 (6 of 10 live chunks); up to 0.02 outside [0, 1] is a warning and is clamped by the robot.
Workspace and tool separation require forward kinematics (dreamguard.sim.SimKinematics, grasp_site in the world frame); without it every action is blocked (fail closed).
Workspace: the table area (x -0.15..0.85 m, y -0.75..0.75 m) from 1 cm above the table top (z 0.75 m) up to 1.6 m.
